seo_title: Wego Case Study: Middle East Travel Content | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read 16,235 pieces of travel media across 6 Middle East markets and 8 brands, finding 6 traveller personas and gaps such as luxury travel in KSA.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Travel · Middle East
h1: Wego and 7 rivals lean on adventure and may miss luxury travel in KSA
h1_em: and may miss luxury travel in KSA
lede: For Wego, SOMIN read 16,235 pieces of paid and organic media from 8 travel brands in 6 Middle East markets. Adventure Explorers led 6 personas with 1,125 unique media; luxury travel in KSA looked underused.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · 2023 to 2024 · Middle East

challenge.title: Wego against 7 travel brands in 6 Middle East markets
challenge.body: Wego's rivals range from ITL Group and Dadabhai to Regency, Cozmo and Almulla. The study asked who they talk to, what about, how they relate and which challenges they address.

approach.title: Personas, topics, relatability and challenges, by market
points: Gathered paid and organic media, with country filters on ads.
Clustered it with SOMIN's semantic models.
Compared clusters by market, then each brand's focus within it.
Defined a test-and-learn process for the findings.

findings_title: Adventure dominates, KSA luxury lags and Kuwait has specialists

findings.title: Adventure is the default
findings.body: Adventure Explorers leads the region; Family Explorers is second in every market except Kuwait.

findings.title: Luxury in KSA is underused
findings.body: Luxury Adventurers ranks 3rd to 4th in most markets but 5th in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain.

findings.title: Kuwait has specialists
findings.body: KAPICO and Regency focus on luxury personas, Alghanim Travel on Thrifty Explorers, and Family Explorers is less crowded.

delivered.title: 6 traveller personas and 6 topics by market and brand
points: Media counts per brand and market
Personas: Adventure Explorers, Luxury Adventurers and the Soulful, Thrifty, Family and Festive Explorers
Topics led by global travel destinations (491 unique media) and travel offers and packages (456)
A test-and-learn route to communication directions

quote.text: This shows that the tracked brands used to understand the market may not be capitalizing on luxury travel in KSA.

outcome.title: Wego can test luxury in KSA and families in Kuwait
outcome.body: Open lanes include luxury travel in KSA, Family Explorers in Kuwait and Thrifty Explorers in the UAE. Generate angles, adopt, test and learn, then reinforce what works.

faq.q: Which markets and brands were covered?
faq.a: Bahrain, KSA, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar and the UAE, and 8 brands: Wego, ITL Group, Dadabhai, Alghanim Travel, KAPICO, Regency, Cozmo and Almulla.
It can. Some pages are regional, so media may repeat across market datasets.
X-means clustering on ADA embeddings with SOMIN's audience semantic model.
